title: Loop Space Splittings for Codimensional Sphere Bundles
summary: In this paper, we establish two loop decomposition theorems for sphere bundles of real vector bundles under appropriate connectivity and characteristic class assumptions. Specifically, we treat two families of sphere bundles: those arising from rank-$(n-1)$ vector bundles and those from rank-$(n-3)$ vector bundles over closed smooth $n$-manifolds.
